company.shortDescription: Raseed is a fintech investment platform that enables individuals in the Middle East and North Africa.
company.description:
Raseed is a fintech investment platform that enables individuals in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region to access global financial markets and invest in international stocks and financial instruments. The platform aims to simplify investing by providing users with digital tools that allow them to buy, sell, and manage investments through a secure and user-friendly mobile and web interface.

Raseed focuses on making global investing more accessible by reducing traditional barriers such as high fees, complex account processes, and limited access to foreign markets. Through its platform, users can explore investment opportunities, track market performance, and build diversified portfolios using real-time financial data and analytics.
